name: Uchinomiya Satomi
source:
Satomi is the Vice President of the Student Council. He has lots of issues with germs and carries some kind of spray with him at all times. He has a lot of respect for Kuroki Fumi, the student council president. He does not get along well with Kiyoko.

[From [url=https://zetsubou-prison.fandom.com/wiki/Satomi]Zetsubou Prison Wiki[/url]]
